description: Validated settings governing keyword/semantic retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion.

top_k.description: Maximum number of optional primary facts admitted (0 is allowed)
top_k.title: Top K

per_channel_limit.description: Per-query candidate pool limit for each channel (keyword and semantic)
per_channel_limit.title: Per Channel Limit

rrf_k.description: RRF smoothing constant k in sum(1 / (k + rank))
rrf_k.title: Rrf K

multi_query_aggregation.description: Aggregation method across multiple requirement queries
multi_query_aggregation.title: Multi Query Aggregation

tie_break_order.description: Ordered tie-break criteria for equal fused scores
tie_break_order.title: Tie Break Order

strict_parents.description: If True, missing/restricted optional parent raises permission error
strict_parents.title: Strict Parents

semantic_threshold.description: Optional minimum semantic similarity cutoff; None initially
semantic_threshold.title: Semantic Threshold

max_queries.description: Maximum number of requirement queries processed
max_queries.title: Max Queries

max_query_chars.description: Maximum character length per requirement query
max_query_chars.title: Max Query Chars

title: RetrievalSettings
